reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, and a named lab with the report for my exact batch is the first time a supplement has given me something I can check. At $24.99 for one box I'd try it once.
objection: I'm not sure I even need it until I get a blood test, and I don't know why it's only one form of magnesium when others put several in one capsule. I won't reorder unless my doctor says it's worth it.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the actual lab report with the lab's name and a result I can look up, or my doctor telling me to skip it.
